EXT. TEMIS ROOFTOPS - SUNSET 

PLAYER crests the rooftop and looks down at a MASSIVE CROWD in celebration.
ADREONA THE AMAZON QUEEN is standing next to a CEREMONIAL BOWL filled with water. With a flourish, she beckons Akarat onstage.

AKARAT comes forward, puts his hands in bowl. 
Adreona: "AY-dree-oh-nah"

AKARAT comes forward, puts his hands in bowl. 
Adreona: "AY-dree-oh-nah"

Adreona takes Akarat’s hand. 

The crowd CHEERS. 

But someone emerges from the shadows behind the stage. It’s LORATH. 

Adreona: "AY-dree-oh-nah"
Lorath nears the Queen's side.
Adreona turns, sees Lorath, and scoffs. She's been waiting for Lorath to return for years, but not like this.
The Crowd MURMURS, unsure what this intrusion means.
Lorath huddles. It's imperative that Adreona hear what he has to say.
Akarat circles Adreona and Lorath.
Adreona is more puzzled than afraid.
Lorath leans in, sincere. He reaches out and takes Adreona’s hand. She doesn’t pull away.

ON AKARAT, his eyes burning red. He speaks and it is the voice of MEPHISTO.  

The world around him is shifting to a strange “other” realm.

Adreona doesn’t notice. She’s still considering.  

The platform – and Temis itself – fades away. Lorath and Akarat stand in a strange mindscape. 

Lorath scowls at Akarat.
The TRUE FORM OF MEPHISTO appears behind Akarat. Not threatening or aggressive. Merely watching.
The tendrils start to pull Lorath closer to Akarat - and the huge form of Mephisto looming in the background. Lorath puts his hand on his knife.
Tendrils from Akarat creep out and start to wrap around Lorath.
Lorath  PLUNGES the blade into Akarat's neck.
Akarat GASPS and crumples to the ground.
Akarat is prone on the ground, choking, dying.
Lorath stands over the dying “prophet,” breathing HARD. But then -

ADREONA is there, dying. A POOL OF BLOOD spreads at her feet.  AKARAT stands at her side, sorrow on his face.

Adreona stares at Lorath from the ground, betrayed and heartbroken. Adreona DIES.
Lorath is HORRIFIED, CONFUSED. He drops his knife.

BACK TO REALITY/TEMIS 

The crowd ERUPTS. 

The Queen's Guard TACKLES Lorath. 

Lorath looks up at Akarat. He knows Akarat is to blame. He knows it's not his fault... Doesn't he?
The crowd goes quiet. Akarat is holding the Queen's body in his arms, weeping.

Akarat kneels by Adreona. He kisses her forehead.  

BEAT. 

Adreona BREATHES. A GASP rolls through the crowd, then AWED SILENCE. 

Adreona sits up.

Lorath watches her, stunned. 

Adreona is stunned too. Adreona looks at Akarat in wonder.
Akarat smiles gently.
Akarat offers his hand. Adreona takes it. She stands.
Akarat turns to the crowd, hands spread.
Akarat's speech drones on in the background...
WIDE SHOT of the ceremonial area. The crowd CHEERS. Player looks on.
Akarat's speech drones on in the background...
